Here is a comprehensive overview of the hotel brands most commonly considered for hotels with a **branded residences component in the Caribbean and Latin America (CALA)**:

---

## 🏨 Hotel Brands with Branded Residences in the Caribbean & Latin America

### 1. **Marriott International** (Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, JW Marriott, W, EDITION, Luxury Collection)

Marriott International's collection of luxury branded residences includes properties under the Ritz-Carlton and St. Regis brands, with other subsidiaries including EDITION, the Luxury Collection, and JW Marriott.
 
The company is seeing its most aggressive growth in the Caribbean and Latin America, where Marriott has 15 properties operating and 42 more in development.
 
In the luxury space, being able to use branded residences as leverage in the development process has been extremely important, according to Hugo Mirabal, director of feasibility and development at Marriott International.
 A key example in the region is 
The Ritz-Carlton Residences, Riviera Maya — a private master-planned beachfront community offering fully furnished branded residences with direct access to private Caribbean shoreline.


---

### 2. **Hilton** (Waldorf Astoria, LXR Hotels & Resorts, Conrad)

Demand for residential units in the CALA region has increased by 14%, according to Pamela Vasquez, Senior Director of Development for Hilton in the region.
 
In 2025, Waldorf Astoria Residences Costa Rica debuted, and Hilton signed Waldorf Astoria Residences Guadalajara, the first standalone Waldorf Astoria branded residences in the Caribbean and Latin America.
 
Hilton also signed a new ultra-luxury resort and residences in Manuel Antonio, Costa Rica, which will offer 170 guest rooms and one- to four-bedroom homes and is slated to join the LXR Hotels & Resorts collection in 2029.
 
The pipeline also includes the Waldorf Astoria Dellis Cay and AMARIS Grace Bay (LXR Hotels & Resorts) in Turks & Caicos, as well as the Waldorf Astoria San Miguel de Allende and Conrad Los Cabos in Mexico.


---

### 3. **Four Seasons**

Four Seasons offers branded residences in locations ranging from London to the Caribbean, with a strong focus on impeccable service standards, and more than half of its development pipeline includes residential components.
 
Four Seasons Resort and Residences at Tropicalia, for example, is located on a 60-acre site along the pristine beachfront of Playa Esmeralda in the northeastern Dominican Republic. The property will include a 95-key resort and 25 private residences of three- and four-bedroom units, all located steps from the beach.


---

### 4. **Hyatt** (Park Hyatt, Andaz, Alila, Grand Hyatt)

Carlos Crovato, head of development, lifestyle at Hyatt Hotels Corp., noted that "for mixed-use developments with residential, most of our projects are going to have that component," with the market and owners very much interested in faster returns on investment.
 
Hyatt's Andaz brand has entered the branded residences space with residences on Grace Bay in Turks and Caicos.


---

### 5. **IHG** (Six Senses, Kimpton, InterContinental)

Across Mexico, Latin America and the Caribbean, IHG expects to add 32 hotels spanning its luxury and lifestyle brands, building on 2024 openings including Six Senses La Sagesse Grenada and Hotel Indigo Grand Cayman. Many of these will offer branded residences, including a forthcoming joint Kimpton hotel and residences offering in Tulum, Mexico.
 
Kimpton Monterrey is also scheduled to open in 2026, bringing a new boutique luxury hotel and branded residences to Mexico's second largest economic market, occupying space in Torre Rise, which will be the tallest tower in Latin America upon completion.
 Meanwhile, 
Six Senses' director of development noted that offering branded residences is more than just a bonus, especially with deals that are $3 million-plus a key — calling branded residences a "requirement, not a cherry on top, especially in the ultra-luxury world."


---

### 6. **Accor** (Fairmont, Raffles, Sofitel, SLS)

Accor is among Marriott's closest rivals by property count in branded residences globally.
 In Latin America, Accor is represented through brands like Fairmont, which has a branded residences offering at Mayakoba in Mexico. 
Within Mayakoba's resort destination, private residences include Fairmont Heritage Place Mayakoba, alongside Rosewood Residences Mayakoba.


---

### 7. **Rosewood Hotels & Resorts**

Rosewood is among the luxury players that have grown significantly in the branded residences space, offering travelers permanent accommodation at iconic destinations with the added comforts of home.
 The brand has established a presence in the CALA region, with 
Rosewood Residences Mayakoba as part of a portfolio that also includes One&Only Mandarina Private Homes in Mexico.


---

### 8. **Aman Resorts**

Aman Resorts is renowned for incorporating wellness philosophies into every detail of its branded projects.
 
Aman Resorts offers residences worldwide, from Thailand to Turks and Caicos.
 In the Dominican Republic, 
Amanera is the first golf-integrated Aman Resort in the world, centered around the world-class Playa Grande Golf Course.


---

### 9. **Mandarin Oriental**

Mandarin Oriental is among the major hotel brands dominating the branded residences sector globally.
 The brand is active in Latin America, having been represented in destinations like Mexico City.

---

### 10. **One&Only Resorts**

One&Only Mandarina and One&Only Mandarina Private Homes are among the notable luxury branded residences developments in Mexico.


---

### 11. **Banyan Tree**
Banyan Tree also participates in the branded residences market in the region. 
Within Mayakoba, four luxury hotels including Banyan Tree are complemented by branded private residences.


---

## Key Takeaway


For the most part, luxury hoteliers in the Caribbean region won't be talking about new developments without mentioning residential opportunities in the same breath, as providing branded residences is a win-win scenario for owners who can see a faster return on investment with buyers coming in on the rental units.
 The dominant brands in this space — **Marriott (Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis), Hilton (Waldorf Astoria, LXR), Four Seasons, Hyatt (Andaz, Park Hyatt), IHG (Six Senses, Kimpton), Accor (Fairmont, Raffles), Rosewood, Aman, and One&Only** — are all actively expanding their branded residences footprint across the Caribbean and Latin America.
